cmd.configureCliTool: Configure Coding CLI (Codex, Claude Code, Cline…)
cfg.routes: List of OmniRoute servers (routes) to expose models from. Each needs an id, a display name and a base URL; API keys are stored securely per route.
cfg.baseUrlDeprecated: Deprecated: use omnicopilot.routes instead (one entry per server). The legacy value migrates automatically to the first route.
cfg.baseUrl: OmniRoute base URL (OpenAI-compatible). Point it at your local install or any remote OmniRoute instance.
cfg.statusBar: Show the OmniRoute connection indicator in the status bar.
cfg.fallbackMode: How aggressively a failing chat request falls back to other models/servers.
cfg.fallbackMode.none: Never fall back — the request fails with the selected model only.
cfg.fallbackMode.sameModel: Only retry the same model id on other configured servers.
cfg.fallbackMode.sameFamily: Also fall back within the same provider family on the same server (default).
cfg.fallbackMode.full: Full fallback: same model on other servers, same family locally, then any compatible model anywhere.
cfg.retriesPerServer: How many full attempts each server gets before the next server is tried. Your selected model is attempted this many times on its own server first.
cfg.maxTools: Maximum number of tools to send to the model. Large tool counts can cause server errors (e.g. 503 Structurally heavy).
cfg.healthCheckIntervalSeconds: How often the status bar probes the OmniRoute server (seconds).
cfg.maxOutputTokens: Maximum output tokens reserved per response.
cfg.defaultContextLength: Context length assumed for models whose catalog entry does not declare one.
cfg.modelFilter: Optional case-insensitive substring or regex to limit which models are listed in the picker (e.g. "glm|kimi"). Empty lists everything.
cfg.dashboardOpen.external: Open the dashboard in your default web browser.
cfg.dashboardOpen.editor: Open the dashboard in a VS Code editor tab (Simple Browser). Requires an OmniRoute version that allows embedding.
cfg.modelCacheTtlMinutes: How often in minutes to refresh the model catalog automatically (default 15 minutes). Set to 0 for manual sync only.
cfg.cliPath: Path to the OmniRoute CLI, used by the "Configure Coding CLI" command.
